translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.87:1: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High
verses.87:3: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly
verses.87:5: then reduces it to withered chaff
verses.87:6: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺
verses.87:7: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden
verses.87:8: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease
verses.87:9: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺
verses.87:10: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺
verses.87:11: But it will be shunned by the most wretched
verses.87:12: who will burn in the greatest Fire
verses.87:13: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die
verses.87:14: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves
verses.87:15: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray
verses.87:16: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world
verses.87:17: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting
verses.87:18: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—
verses.87:19: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses
